translation.name: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau
translation.englishName: Kilivila: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau Bible

content: Mina watanawa bisuvisi osi boda Yaubada la tomota
E Guyau iluki la tomota kawala, “Kuvagaisi avaka bibudoki karaiwaga duwosisia deli kumitukwaibwailasi, paila yeigu makateki wala bakatumovaimi.
E yeigu bamitukwaii matausina availa availa ikabikaulasi Sabate kala karaiwaga, e deli gala iiyogwalaisi yam makwaina. E yeigu bamitukwaii matausina availa availa gala iuvagaisi avai mitugaga.”

E togilagala matauna bogwa eisuvi osi boda Guyau la tomota, gala ibodi bilivala kawala, “Kaina Guyau gala bitagwala bakatapwarorusi deli la tomota.” E tau matauna wowola bogwa eikivaisi, gala avai tuta ibodi binanamsa gala ibodi bisuvi osi boda Yaubada la tomota kalubikoya gala gagabila biunai gugwadi.

E Guyau bilivala baisa matauwena kawala, “Kidamwa bukuuvagi makawala karaiwogala Sabate e metoya baisa bukutemmalaigu, deli goli kidamwa bukuuvagi avaka avaka biyomwasalaigu e deli m kwamaiaba bukuiyamati ulo kabutu,

tomota biluluwaisi yagam ogu Bwala Kwebumaboma deli goli oluwalaisi ulo tomota. E luluwai baisa kala kaduwonaku bikalisau avaka tomota biluluwaisi kidamwa bukuunai bidubadu litumwa tauwau deli vivila! Yoku gala avai tuta bilumwelavaimsi.”

E baisa matausina mina gilagala bogwa eisuvisi osi boda la tomota, matausina iyebwailisi e iwotitalaisi matauna, deli iuvagaisi makawala Sabate kala karaiwaga, deli iiyamataisi la kabutu deli si kamaiaba, Guyau eilivala kawala,
“Ka, yeigu goli bamaiyaimi ogu koya kwebumaboma
Saiyoni, e basakaimi mwasawa ogu Bwala makwaina bolela nigada, deli yeigu bakabwaili mi lula makwaisina bukululasi ogu kabolula. Ulo bwala bidokaisi bolela nigada paila komwaidosi mina watanawa.”
Guyau Yaubada bogwa leimai la tomota mina Isireli osi valu metoya okatupipi, e bogwa eikatotila mwada igau bimai tuvaila ituwoli tomota e bisuvisi osi boda la tomota.
Guyau bogwa leiluki boda ituwoli ituwoli bimaisi makawala mauna nabubolodila bikomasi la tomota.

Matauna eilivala kawala, “Tokugwa matausina mwada bikatululutaisi ulo tomota, mitaga komwaidosi wala tokugwa mina kau! Matausina gala wala avaka inikolaisi. Matausina makawala kaukwa mitaga gala inikolaisi gwau - ikanukwenusi wala imimimisi. Iyebwailisi wala masisi!

Matausina makawala kaukwa minasina ikikommagasisi mitaga gala ililakoli luposi kamkwam. Tokugwa matausina gala wala itapuloki ninasi. Matausina bivavagisi wala avaka ititaki ninasi deli inainevisi avaka kasi bwaina titoulesi.
Matausina mina mommata bililivalasi kawasi, ‘Tauwau, ibodi bitamomsi waini bitamomwaisi wala bitakatukopwisi. E nabwaia bikalisau kala bwaina momom, gala makawala lagaila.’”
